# RIP Tutorial

> > Community-curated archive of Stack Overflow documentation covering 1000+ programming languages, frameworks, and tools with practical code examples.

RIP Tutorial preserves and organizes the Stack Overflow documentation project, making it accessible through topic, tag, and example-based browsing. It serves as a comprehensive learning resource for developers across all skill levels seeking hands-on tutorials and reference material.

## Key Topics

- C#
- Python
- PHP
- C++
- .NET Framework
- Entity Framework
- SQL Server
- MySQL
- PostgreSQL
- Dapper ORM
- ASP.NET MVC
- Web Development
- Database Querying
- Getting Started
- Code Examples

## Browse & Discover

- [Tutorial by Topics](https://riptutorial.com/topic): Browse archived Stack Overflow documentation by topic
- [Tutorial by Tags](https://riptutorial.com/tag): Browse archived Stack Overflow documentation by technology tags
- [Tutorial by Examples](https://riptutorial.com/example): Browse archived Stack Overflow documentation by code examples
- [eBooks by Tags](https://riptutorial.com/ebook): eBook library from Stack Overflow community contributions

## Programming Languages

- [C# Language Tutorial](https://riptutorial.com/csharp): C# language tutorial: basics, syntax & Visual Studio setup
- [Python Language Tutorial](https://riptutorial.com/python): Python language tutorial: basics, syntax & version comparison
- [PHP Tutorial](https://riptutorial.com/php): PHP language tutorial: basics, installation & web development
- [C++ Tutorial](https://riptutorial.com/cplusplus): C++ programming tutorial: hello world, stdlib & standards

## .NET & Web Frameworks

- [.NET Framework Tutorial](https://riptutorial.com/dot-net): .NET Framework fundamentals: CLR, MSIL & architecture
- [EF Core with MVC - Overview](https://riptutorial.com/ef-core-with-mvc/learn/100000/overview): EF Core & ASP.NET Core MVC tutorial overview and fundamentals
- [EF 6 + MVC - Overview](https://riptutorial.com/ef6-with-mvc/learn/100000/overview): Entity Framework 6 with ASP.NET MVC tutorial overview
- [Dapper + MVC - Overview](https://riptutorial.com/dapper-with-mvc/learn/100000/overview): Dapper ORM with ASP.NET Core MVC tutorial introduction

## Databases & ORMs

- [Microsoft SQL Server Tutorial](https://riptutorial.com/sql-server): SQL Server tutorial: T-SQL basics, tables & querying
- [MySQL Tutorial](https://riptutorial.com/mysql): MySQL tutorial: database creation, tables & SQL operations
- [PostgreSQL Tutorial](https://riptutorial.com/postgresql): PostgreSQL tutorial: installation, setup & database basics
- [SQLite Tutorial](https://riptutorial.com/sqlite): SQLite tutorial: installation, setup & basic operations
- [Dapper.NET Tutorial](https://riptutorial.com/dapper): Dapper micro-ORM tutorial: installation, querying & usage
- [EF Core Providers - Getting Started](https://riptutorial.com/ef-core-providers/learn/100000/getting-started): Getting started with EF Core database providers & SQL Server
